g.aria-label: Distribution-Free Uniform Convergence Bound (VC Dimension / Rademacher)
ε(f) ≤ ε_S(f) + B(ℱ, n, δ) [where B depends ONLY on class ℱ and sample size n]
Same MLP class ℱ, same n = 1,000
True test error is chance: ε(f_rand) = 0.90
Because B(ℱ, n, δ) is label-blind:
even though real test error is ~19%!
Takeaway: Overparameterized generalization cannot be explained by raw capacity ceilings |ℱ|;
it depends on which specific interpolator SGD selects on structured vs. noisy data.
